genes.csv.description: per scenario: the 400 genes in selection order with their mean and variance over all cells

niche_example_mean.npz.description: top-400 expressed genes: the largest niche's mean correlation matrix (float32) in its gene order, block runs, niche, tiles, gene names (as R10's niche_example)

niche_example_var.npz.description: top-400 variable genes: the largest niche's mean correlation matrix (float32) in its gene order, block runs, niche, tiles, gene names (as R10's niche_example)

tile_means.csv.description: per scenario (var: top-400 variable genes, the index's; mean: top-400 expressed) and index tile (seed-0 split): niche, mean |r| over its within-block and between-block gene pairs (pairs with a gene without counts in the tile left out), pair counts, genes with counts
